title: SubagentStop auto-spawns one edm-qc-auditor per parallel implementer, each instructed to Write the same qc/qc-summary.md, so 6-10 concurrent full-file writes silently discard all but the last auditor's PASS/FAIL verdicts before Step 5 compiles FAILs from that file

NEW from the CA-397 fix: EDM_STATE_LOCK_WAIT_S is unvalidated at top level under set -e, so a fractional value aborts every subcommand at load with a raw bash arithmetic error and a non-numeric value makes flock -w fail instantly and report a fabricated lock timeout on the first attempt

T-EDMV4 reads .audit_rounds.code.count without coerce_round_entry at :2212 and :3016, violating the documented C-4 bare-integer contract; jq raises 'Cannot index number with count' (// 0 does not catch it) and approve-gate --accept-p2-debt aborts on a legacy state file with a raw jq error

cmd_archive's P2-debt staleness gate compares two jq-derived values with [[ -eq ]] without routing either through to_int, the exact arithmetic-context class CA-157/to_int's docstring requires every state-file-sourced value to pass through

_cmd_migrate_path_rollback_body renames the locked directory back to src while with_state_lock holds a lock keyed on the dst path, so the post-body rm -rf targets a path that no longer exists and the lockdir leaks into the restored initiative; both forward movers sweep the destination for exactly this reason

EDM_EVAL_KEEP_RUNS=0 passes the digit-only validator, so tail -n +1 selects every run directory including the one just written; the EXIT-trap prune deletes it and CI's two 'if [ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]' guards then skip scoring and baseline comparison silently, reporting eval:nightly green with no eval performed

EDM_EVAL_PHASE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is unvalidated and this driver deliberately runs without set -e, so a non-numeric value makes [ "$waited" -ge "$seconds" ] return 2 and be read as false: the timeout branch never fires and the claude -p child runs unbounded, defeating the G45 guarantee that every model call is bounded

NEW from the CA-397 fix: the G53 awk anchor '^    \( flock -w 10 200' no longer matches the renamed call, so sed -n '1175,1p' extracts one line and all three CA-169 never-unlink-the-flock-file assertions now pass vacuously; second recurrence of this fragile-anchor class after G38/CA-314

cmd_checkpoint's drift loop packs four fields into one space-delimited line and splits with read, so a recorded artifact path containing a space truncates file_path, artifact_hash returns 'absent', and the != absent guard skips the comparison -- drift detection fails silently open for that initiative

One trap body for EXIT INT TERM HUP with no exit on the three signals, contrary to bin/edm-state's own CA-143 contract: an interrupt deletes $tmp and then resumes, so --check (the mode CI runs) reports a fabricated 'out of sync with CLAUDE.md' failure and write mode dies on mv of a deleted temp file

CA-354 verified FIXED: read+render+write_atomic now run under one with_state_lock on the ledger's own lockbase, with record_artifact_hash deliberately outside after release; the locked body's die propagates through the caller's own die at :4199

CA-355 verified FIXED: the pre-flight now resolves through the same fence-aware pattern_insert_line_for the body uses, refusing loudly on fence-only ambiguity (:5083) and skipping cleanly on genuine absence (:5085), with the body re-checking under the lock at :5001-5003

CA-396 verified FIXED via ${BASHPID:-$$}; TMPDIR placement independently judged correct and safer than lockbase-adjacent. Residual: the comment claims BASHPID is the subshell's PID, but the assignment happens in the parent before the fork -- uniqueness still holds, the rationale does not

CA-398 verified FIXED and the mandate's specific hazard is absent: _lock_retry_or_die takes the counter as $1, returns 1 instead of calling die, and all three call sites' || die runs in the non-subshell until-loop body so exit terminates the real process

eval:nightly's 150m job timeout exceeds the ~140m worst-case inner budget, so the nesting direction is correct -- but the ~10m margin is undocumented and silently inverts if a fourth phase is added or the phase timeout is raised

approve-gate --accept-p2-debt reads state and the ledger unlocked before the locked rmw_state write, but cmd_archive independently re-verifies P0/P1 at :3021 and refuses on a newer completed round; a stale debt round also fails closed

edm-lint-artifacts:141 and edm-check-grants:127 share L3-10's cleanup-then-resume trap shape, but both are read-only scanners so the consequence is a wrong exit code rather than a corrupted artifact; fix alongside L3-10, not independently actionable
